description.zh: 查询结束时间；格式:"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
description.en: Specifies the query's end time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time range between StartTime and EndTime must be within the same month. If unspecified, the default is the last day of the current month.
The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过500，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. Value range: 1–500. Default: 10.

description.zh: 推送结果；取值：1、成功，0、失败
description.en: The push result. Valid values: 1: Success, 0: Failed.
The number of retries. The default is -2.

description.zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The pagination offset. The value must be 0 or greater. Default: 0.

description.zh: 查询开始时间；格式:"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
description.en: Specifies the query's start time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time range between StartTime and EndTime must be within the same month. If unspecified, the default is the first day of the current month.

description.zh: 推送类型；1:来电推送、2:来电响铃推送、3:外呼响铃推送、4:webcall转座席响铃推送、5:来电接通推送、6:外呼接通推送、7:来电挂机推送、8:外呼挂机推送、9:座席状态推送、10:按键推送、11:号码状态识别推送、12:录音状态推送、13:HTTP交互推送、15:ASR语音转换结果推送、14:预测式外呼任务推送、16:webcall客户侧响铃推送、17:满意度调查推送、18:预测外呼客户接听状态推送、19:NLU推送、20:预测外呼双方接听推送、21:IVR交互结束推送、22:外呼客户响铃推送、23:webcall客户接听推送、24:webcall转接响铃推送、25:webcall转接接通推送、26:主叫外呼分机响铃推送、27:主叫外呼分机接听推送、28:主叫外呼客户响铃推送、29:主叫外呼双方接通推送
description.en: The push type. Valid values: 1: Inbound call, 2: Inbound call ringing, 3: Outbound call ringing, 4: WebCall transfer to agent ringing, 5: Inbound call connected, 6: Outbound call connected, 7: Inbound call hang-up, 8: Outbound call hang-up, 9: Agent status, 10: Keypress, 11: Number status detection, 12: Recording status, 13: HTTP interaction, 14: Predictive outbound call task, 15: ASR result, 16: WebCall customer-side ringing, 17: Customer satisfaction survey, 18: Predictive outbound call customer answer status, 19: NLU, 20: Predictive outbound call both parties connected, 21: IVR interaction end, 22: Outbound call customer ringing, 23: WebCall customer answered, 24: WebCall transfer ringing, 25: WebCall transfer connected, 26: Agent-initiated outbound call extension ringing, 27: Agent-initiated outbound call extension answered, 28: Agent-initiated outbound call customer ringing, 29: Agent-initiated outbound call both parties connected.
